data.one_liner: Generate and visualize word clouds in Flutter with shape, color, and click support.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to create word cloud visualizations from a dataset of words and values. It supports shapes like circles and ellipses, custom color lists, font styling, background decorations, and interactive clickable words via WordCloudTapView.
use_when: You need to visualize text data frequencies as a word cloud in a Flutter app.
You want interactive words that trigger actions when tapped.
avoid_when: You need complex data graphs other than word clouds.
You require advanced layout algorithms not covered by circle or ellipse shapes.
strengths: Supports custom shapes such as circles and ellipses.
Provides interactive click handling for words in the cloud.
Customizable font styling, sizes, and color lists.
weaknesses: Limited to circle and ellipse shapes.
Increasing the attempt parameter to fit all words can cause performance slowdowns.
data.minimal_example:
WordCloudData mydata = WordCloudData(data: [{'word': 'Apple','value': 100}]);
WordCloudView(data: mydata, mapwidth: 500, mapheight: 500);
